title: caseOutcomeSchema
responsibility: Defines strict revision-bound test-case identities, runner outcomes and immutable evidence file descriptors.

outputs.name: caseFileSchema
outputs.description: Accepts only nonempty repository-relative test file paths without traversal segments.

outputs.name: caseOutcomeSchema
outputs.description: Defines the exact test title, file, source revision, retry and passed, failed or skipped outcome recorded by a runner.

outputs.name: evidenceArtifactSchema
outputs.description: Defines the original evidence file path, SHA-256 digest and nonnegative byte count retained with a verification record.
